table.MR_WHICH_BOX: {count} of your mailboxes have an e-mail {n}: {list}.
table.MR_TOO_MANY: I found {count} e-mails that fit; say more words of the sender or the subject.
table.MR_NONE: I found no e-mail with those words in the newest snapshot of your mailboxes.
table.MR_ASK: Which e-mail? Say its number, or some words of its sender or subject.
table.MR_PAST_END: {box} has {count} e-mails in its newest snapshot, so there is no e-mail {n} there.
table.MR_UNAVAILABLE: I could not read that e-mail just now. Ask for the list of your e-mails again, then for its number.
table.MR_PICK: Say “read {n} from {box}”, with the number and the mailbox of the one you want.
table.MR_WHICH_SAY_ONE: Say “read {n} from {box}” to read the one in {box}.
table.MR_WHICH_PAGE: Some of these mailboxes belong to the same account, so I cannot tell them apart by words here: choose it {where}
table.MR_WHICH_TYPED: Name the one you mean with --message {refs}.
table.MR_BOX_NOTE: I could not read {boxes} just now, so there may be more.
table.MR_BOX_FAILED: I could not read {boxes} just now, so I will not guess which e-mail {n} you mean. Try again in a few minutes.
table.MR_DAY_UNREAD: I could not tell which day you mean, or an e-mail has no time recorded, so I did not choose by date. Say its number or some words of its sender or subject.
table.UNDERSTOOD_MAIL_READ_WORDS: show the text of the e-mail with “{words}”
table.UNDERSTOOD_MAIL_READ_DAY: show the text of the e-mail of “{day}”
table.UNDERSTOOD_MAIL_READ_WORDS_DAY: show the text of the e-mail with “{words}” of “{day}”
